SelectedPracticeRoute.PaperEvidence: original design, replication, labelled procedure, peer feedback and teacher-scored signed review

Task.Prompt: Using an independently provided labelled hexagon-based design, observe and reconstruct it with precise compass/straightedge moves. Create a new design and written steps; trade instructions without showing the original, independently reproduce it and justify at least two congruences. Record one revision after feedback.

Criteria.Criterion: identifies repeated structures and at least one defensible geometric question from an original independent design (22.1)
reconstructs a labelled hexagon-based pattern using correct straightedge-compass steps and names at least one valid rigid motion (22.2)
produces an original design with ordered, reproducible centre/radius/intersection instructions (22.3)
independent peer uses the hidden-design instructions, identifies congruent parts with reasons, and the author resolves ambiguity (22.4)

Items.SourceFocus: regular-hexagon design: two congruent figure pairs
Items.ExpectedTeacherEvidence: teacher checks corresponding figures and a valid rigid-motion/construction congruence reason, not imagined publisher labels
teacher checks a correct rotation/reflection that maps the entire given diagram to itself; a hexagon alone does not prove decoration symmetry

Items.SourceFocus: triangle constructions from two translations of B
Items.ExpectedTeacherEvidence: teacher checks correct translated-point correspondences and the congruence argument

Items.SourceFocus: two given congruence relationships and triangle angle measures
Items.ExpectedTeacherEvidence: teacher checks diagram-specific vertex correspondence and angle sum, no fabricated scalar angles without image

Items.SourceFocus: parallel transversal select-all from angle 3 congruent angle 6
Items.ExpectedTeacherEvidence: teacher checks the precise original figure and converse angle theorem; diagram required

Items.SourceFocus: midpoint 180-degree rotation image and preserved angles
Items.ExpectedTeacherEvidence: teacher checks M midpoint, half-turn sends A to C and carries rays/angle measure correctly

Items.SourceFocus: perpendicular lines plus angle bisectors select-all
Items.ExpectedTeacherEvidence: teacher checks ray order and marked bisectors from original figure; no auto-selected option letters

Items.SourceFocus: two intersecting lines fixed by a rotation
Items.ExpectedTeacherEvidence: 180-degree rotation about their intersection takes each complete line to itself; any nontrivial allowed angle must be justified

Items.SourceFocus: reflection then directed translation of a triangle
Items.ExpectedTeacherEvidence: teacher checks composition order, mapped vertices and image drawing

Items.SourceFocus: rotation about T then translation and alternative sequence
Items.ExpectedTeacherEvidence: teacher checks mapped polygon vertices and an equivalent whole-figure transformation composition

Correct: valid six equal-chord regular-hexagon seed; exact named centres and radii; partner replicates
two congruences justified by matched rigid motion or constructed equality
180-degree half-turn about intersection preserves both whole lines
Equivalent: rotated or translated first-party design with identical construction relations
different legal tool sequence creating congruent figure with reproducible labels
Incorrect: unconstrained visual guess used as proof of congruence
assertion that any decoration of a regular hexagon also has 60-degree rotational symmetry
unjustified original diagram option letters for cumulative select-all
Boundary: degenerate zero-radius initial circle is invalid
circles centred distance d apart with radius d/2 are tangent, not two intersections
valid design with no nontrivial decoration symmetry may still satisfy 22.3 creation but cannot be claimed 22.2 self-motion
Malformed: missing circle centre, radius or intersection branch
illegible drawing without named points or directions
peer copy without original written instructions

FirstPartyCooldown: EDULYTIKS_AUTHORED_ALTERNATIVE: make a new reproducible diagram with one reflection and explain why the mirror matches each named part; teacher scores reasoning and construction.
TeacherHandoff: Paper-only until secure assignment flow is verified: collect original plus peer copy and instruction sheet; score 0/1/2 per criterion, provide date and feedback under school policy; never auto-grade drawing or open proof.

StageD.Required: lesson-selected assignment route, student evidence submission, authorized teacher rubric grade persistence, two-school negatives, renderer and final CI
